description: Deterministic responses the mock ERP PO-lookup API must return, keyed by poNumber. Lab 3's po_lookup applies: matched = found && vendorActive && |invoiceTotal - openAmount| <= 2% of openAmount; approvalRequired = !matched || invoiceTotal > 10000. Unknown PO numbers return found: false.
